senses.gloss:
नमस् nám-as, n. bowing, obeisance, adoration 🞄(by word or gesture): often as an exclamation 🞄with the dat.;
 -kṛ, utter ‘namas.’ make 🞄obeisance, to (ac., d., lc.).
नमस्य namas-yá, den. P. adore, do homage 🞄to, bless (ac.). sam, id.

नमस्वत् námas-vat, a. reverential;
 inspiring 🞄reverence.
नमस्विन् namas-vín, a. id..
नमुचि ná-muci, m. [not letting to the waters], 🞄N. of a demon subdued by Indra: -dviṣ, m. 🞄ep. of Indra.
नमेरु nameru, m. a tree.

नामक nāma-ka, a. (ikā) 〈1.〉 bearing the name 🞄of, named (—˚);
 〈2.〉 (√ nam) bending (—˚).

नामाङ्क nāma‿aṅka, a. marked with a name;
 🞄-aṅkita, pp. id..

नामिक nām-ika, a. (ī) referring to a personal 🞄name;
 nominal (gr.).
नामिन् nām-in, a. having a name.
नाम्य nām-ya, fp. flexible.
